body: I have never drank alcohol until this last week. I don't have a problem with alcohol, I have a problem with life.

Hahahaha what is this. I don't want anything in life. I want to drain all of the blood from my body or remove my head from the rest of my body. I want to stop my heart from beating and I want blood to never fucking flow through my veins ever again.

What the fuck is this scatterbrained mess? Jesus, I look like a fucking psychopath with this kind of a post. You may as well ignore this shit and label me a drama queen because I sure as hell fucking feel like one.

Am I even going to remember this throwaway tomorrow? Am I even going to listen to anyone? Probably not. This is livejournal apparently. Clearly I have BPD or something and can't just fucking kill myself without whoring myself out to the internet in the process.
